title: Gitea variables
description: Configuration variables for the Gitea self-hosted Git service.

GITEA_VERSION.description: Specific version of gitea to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

GITEA_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for gitea: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

GITEA_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for GITEA to listen on

GITEA_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for GITEA to listen on

GITEA_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for GITEA to listen on

GITEA_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading gitea binary or archive artifacts.

GITEA_LISTEN.description: Listen endpoint (address:port or socket) for gitea.

GITEA_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying gitea available remote releases.
